Explanation: A care match connects a family need with a caregiver who fits the required type of care, location, schedule and rate.
Care.com operates the multi-category care marketplace. The company was sold by IAC to an affiliate of Pacific Avenue Capital Partners in March 2026.
Care.com has to help families find suitable caregivers across different care needs without making them start from scratch on a separate platform each time.
Families can return as their needs change, while the platform can extend the same matching and trust infrastructure into adjacent care categories.
Care.com must maintain enough relevant caregivers while managing safety, quality, fraud and uneven local availability across several care categories.
Care.com coordinates job posts, search, profiles, messaging, membership access and, where available, booking or payment tools that lead to a care hire.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Need / Search — Families bring a care need to Care.com by posting a job or searching the marketplace. | → Consumer · Profiles / Tools — Care.com provides search, profiles, reviews, messaging and safety tools that help families choose whom to hire. | ← Provider · Profile / Time — Caregivers provide profiles, skills, rates and availability that make them searchable across care categories. | → Provider · Jobs / Access — Care.com gives caregivers access to family demand, job listings and communication tools. | ← Partner · Checks / Results — First Advantage supplies background-check results that Care.com uses as part of caregiver screening and trust management.
